name: Rasaa
intro: The festive ensemble for 2026. Plain cotton and linen grounds carry their detail at the edges: woven zari borders drawn from temple borders, embroidered floral and geo-floral trims, and small printed buttis.

designs.name: Kinari
designs.story: Kinari Solid Linen is a premium linen blind in a soft beige hue with a woven zari border inspired by the intricate temple borders.

designs.name: Mogra
designs.story: Mogra Walnut Grey is a premium cotton blind in a soft, understated grey, finished with an ornate embroidered floral border in subtle neutral tones.

designs.name: Ketaki
designs.story: Ketaki White is a premium blind curtain featuring a crisp white base adorned with a delicate geo-floral embroidered trim in soft shades of pink and blue.

designs.name: Daaram
designs.story: Daaram is a neutral cotton roman blind crafted with minimal gold zari stripes.

designs.name: Kolam
designs.story: Kolam, a blind combining minimalism with a touch of festivity is inspired by the ethnic art of kolam or rangoli. This blind features a striking print in rich pepper green, accented by an intricate border that adds a subtle yet sophisticated flair.

designs.name: Gulnaar
designs.story: Gulnaar, a floral design printed on a green cotton base inspired by traditional block printing is made into a Blind that accentuates the beauty of any contemporary or traditional home.

designs.name: Baagh
designs.story: Baagh, minimal floral printed blind made of 100% premium cotton is crafted for homes that celebrates minimal ethnic aesthetics.

designs.name: Meher
designs.story: Meher, a block print inspired floral printed blind made of 100% premium cotton is crafted for modern ethnic and contemporary homes.

designs.name: Ira
designs.story: Ira, an embroidered blind showcases ikat inspired delicate geo floral design in soft blues and pinks on a white base.

designs.name: Rohida
designs.story: Cushion cover Rohida featuring contemporized florals on a deep red base is made for traditional, contemporary or ethnic homes.

designs.name: Mudra
designs.story: Cushion cover Mudra featuring small florals in white and gold print on a teal base is made in premium cotton for modern, contemporary and ethnic homes.

designs.name: Nargis
designs.story: Cushion cover Nargis featuring a striking combination of a delicate floral embroidery on a muted green printed base, is made for homes that celebrates contemporary and ethnic aesthetics.

designs.name: Tala
designs.story: Tala, a tropical printed blind featuring elegant Palm trees on a soft cream cotton base is designed especially for contemporary and ethnic homes.

designs.name: Madhuram
designs.story: Madhuram, a printed minimal blind featuring cypress trees and pomegranate motifs in earthy colours, is made for minimal, ethnic and traditional homes.

name: Entwine
intro: Summer 2026. Soft solids finished with embroidered trims in Elba and Glen, alongside light florals and sprigs on cotton: Roselle, Flutter, Peony and Pomera.

designs.name: Glen
designs.story: Glen beige, is a premium cotton blind with an ornate embroidered geometric border on a cream base.

designs.name: Roselle
designs.story: Roselle pink, a very delicate floral sheer blind highlighting dainty florals printed in pink on a white base fabric works extremely well in classic, contemporary homes.

designs.name: Flutter
designs.story: Flutter, a geo-floral blind printed in a soft pink shade with stripes of orchids, and dragonflies, brings in an English garden to modern homes.

designs.name: Feather
designs.story: Feather, a geometric blind printed in muted shades of brown and beige inspired from tribal geometrics, is an ultimate pick for ethnic and modern homes.

designs.name: Pomera
designs.story: Pomera, a premium cotton blind showcasing an intricate work of ethnic floral print on a cream base fabric.

designs.name: Malabar
designs.story: Malabar, an intricate ethnic blind with a floral motif printed on a teal base works beautifully in contemporary or ethnic homes.

designs.name: Field
designs.story: Field, an elegant sheer blind in the shades of brown and grey, features delicate floral bunches printed on a soft cream base fabric.

name: Ratna
intro: The festive collection for 2025. Ikat geometry in royal blue and brick red, crimson and jade grounds with printed floral borders, and repeats named for places and things: Durbar, Palace Pillars, Mulbagal, Meenakshi, Thinnai.

designs.name: Kadamba
designs.story: A minimal yet striking, premium cotton curtain in a deep maroon shade, elevated with a heavy embroidered floral border in vibrant greens and reds.

designs.name: Tara
designs.story: The cool-toned solid base complements the earthy geometric trim, creating a balanced look that blends traditional craftsmanship with modern simplicity.

designs.name: Durbar
designs.story: This eye-catching curtain showcases a striking overall pattern, blending ethnic craftsmanship with a contemporary twist.

designs.name: Palace Pillars
designs.story: Each stripe features a unique and detailed pattern.

designs.name: Pakkshi
designs.story: A geometric floral printed cotton curtain in neutral shades creates a soothing palette that feels both refined and inviting.

designs.name: Palash
designs.story: A premium cotton sheer curtain adorned with Palash-inspired floral motifs, celebrating the beauty of India’s “flame of the forest. ” The floral print stands out against a warm neutral base, bringing a touch of heritage and artistry into modern homes.

designs.name: Thinnai
designs.story: Heritage, reimagined, Thinnai our geometric cotton printed curtain draws inspiration from the attangudi tiles.

designs.name: Neela
designs.story: The deep indigo base, paired with terracotta and ivory accents, adds a rich, handcrafted feel reminiscent of traditional block printing.

name: Pause
intro: Summer 2025. Sheers and printed cottons in sage, mist blue, mustard and rose: small florals, stripes and geometric repeats.

designs.name: Rustle
designs.story: A geometric textured curtain in a soft muted pink hue, inspired by the quiet beauty of nature.

designs.name: Whisper
designs.story: A printed linen curtain with floral bunches in breezy shades of blue, designed to evoke the feeling of blossoms gently swaying in the air.

designs.name: Still Water
designs.story: A geometric sheer curtain with textured stripes in soft blue, blending effortless elegance with a relaxed and airy charm. For a more styled space, try all three together, the textures and tones play off each other effortlessly.

designs.name: Sakura
designs.story: A floral sheer cotton curtain in a delicate blush pink, inspired by the fleeting beauty of Sakura blossoms. A dreamy pick for anyone who loves a calm, nature-inspired vibe.

designs.name: Fable
designs.story: A classic geo-floral curtain with a modern twist. Inspired by timeless antique damask, this design features intricate herringbone-style motifs in soft olive and muted rust tones, earthy hues that bring in a sense of vintage charm and understated elegance.

designs.name: Celeste
designs.story: Celeste Flora & Fauna features delicate wildlife-inspired motifs on a serene Nile blue base, while Stella complements with a soft floral pattern in earthy tones.

designs.name: Sienna
designs.story: A yellow cotton curtain in a warm dusky hue, inspired by traditional Ikat patterns and reimagined with subtle, minimal detailing.

designs.name: Posy
designs.story: The minimal print sheer curtain adds just the right touch of elegance while softly filtering in natural light. Its soft yellow accents make it a lovely choice if you're looking for a yellow sheer curtain with a gentle floral touch.

designs.name: Haze
designs.story: A self-design white print sheer curtain with subtle geometric patterns, this white-on-white beauty is crisp, modern, and quietly elegant. A must-have minimal print sheer curtain for a soft yet stylish update.

name: Earlier seasons
intro: Designs from the seasons before Ratna, 2022 to 2024, still on the shelf: Lotus Pond and Sacred Waters, Pergola, Gingko, Spice Route, Climbing Roses and more.

designs.name: Pergola
designs.story: Our Pergola echoes the iconic arches of the Mediterranean with its geometric yet organic printed texture.

designs.name: Gingko
designs.story: In Japanese decorative art, the ginkgos distinctive fan-shaped leaf has been a symbol of longevity.

designs.name: Eden
designs.story: A minimal and pleasant floral jaal pattern in mustard is inspired by the creepers of the forest.

designs.name: Ivy Vines
designs.story: The first of our embroidered curtain designs. Embroidered in neutral tones to fit seamlessly into any home.

designs.name: Lotus Pond
designs.story: Risen from muddy waters, lotus flowers are a symbol of purity. Our Lotus Pond cotton fabric is a glorious combination of rust and sage green makes a perfect fit for you living/dining room.

designs.name: Spice Route
designs.story: This sage and warm grey java-inspired print is as earthy a tone as they come.

designs.name: Sunbird
designs.story: This fun sheer print sports sunbirds and peacocks, inspired by the tribal representation of birds.

designs.name: Mallige
designs.story: Delicate as a flower garland, our light filtering printed sheer Cotton Curtain features a subtle geometric pattern in rust and mustard. This curtain combines the airy elegance of sheer fabric with a fresh, modern design, showcasing soft, intricate stripes in warm, festive tones.

designs.name: Sitara
designs.story: Featuring subtle stripes with small, intricate motifs, this curtain creates a refined and airy look.

designs.name: Indus
designs.story: The Indus block printed curtain with its amber floral detailing paired with the solid cream sheer is sure to bring in a fresh feel this festive time!
